title: Spacetime Duality Beyond Conformality
summary: We extend the spacetime duality programme of Burgess \textit{et.al.} to massive theories in 1+1 dimensions. For the massive scalar, a heat-kernel computation tracking three contributions to the conformal-mode effective action reveals that the naive leading correction $\sim m^2(e^φ -1)$ to the Liouville action cancels exactly, with the genuine leading deformation being $-\frac{m^2}{16π}(e^φ-1)^{2}$.
